issues.description: Table/prose discrepancies: kaolin Al2O3 39.4/39.5; plastic clay Al2O3 27.4/27.5; tailing CaO 44.6/44.7 and SiO2 20.7/20.8. Preserve both; do not silently reconcile.
LF after drying at 110 C and firing at 1000 C differs from TG total loss. Methods and mass bases are not interchangeable.
Anorthite expansion range rendered as 10^-15 to 10^-6 C^-1 is suspicious. Do not use as a CTE input.
Dashes are unreported, not confirmed zeros. Others are unidentified constituents, not a known oxide.

Firing rate 30 C/min differs from thermal-analysis rate 12.5 C/min. Natural cooling has no measured rate. Air atmosphere is explicitly given for thermal analysis; do not infer the firing atmosphere from electric kiln type.
Classification text references ISO 13006 but reference 39 names ISO 10545-3. Do not turn article classifications into verified standards compliance.

model_implications: Water absorption, open/closed porosity, shrinkage and strength require separate outputs; monotonic densification cannot be assumed at all temperatures.
Keep forming pressure, particle history, geometry and firing schedule with body recipes.
Eight compositions and three target temperatures do not establish 24 independent firing runs or a universal sintering law.
No glaze adhesion data: this body study cannot calibrate glaze-body bond probability.
